metaDescription: Convert a Swagger 2.0 JSON file to OpenAPI 3.0.3 in your browser: servers, components, request bodies, responses, security. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Converts a Swagger 2.0 JSON document to OpenAPI 3.0.3. Host, basePath and schemes become servers, definitions move to components, body and form parameters become request bodies, and security definitions are mapped.
why:
Many tools now expect OpenAPI 3. Upgrading a Swagger 2.0 file by hand means moving every definition, rewriting each $ref, and turning body parameters into requestBody objects.

This converter applies those rules locally. Review the result before you publish it: it covers the common cases, not every vendor extension, and it accepts JSON only. Convert YAML to JSON first. You can check the output with the OpenAPI structural validator.
howTo: Run it through the OpenAPI validator and a diff against your old file.

faq.a: To keep the page small and exact. Use the YAML to JSON converter first.
They become requestBody with one content entry per consumes media type.
type: file becomes a string with format binary, in a multipart form body.
